conditions: It is a calendar (not an event) in Google Calendar.
It appears in Jordan Lee's calendar list.

readings: The entire sidebar list of calendars shown to Jordan Lee, including both owned ('My calendars') and shared/subscribed ('Other calendars') calendars.
Only the 'My calendars' section of the sidebar, i.e., calendars Jordan Lee actually owns.
Perform whatever action the UI labels as 'rename' for that calendar, which for a non-owned/shared calendar only changes Jordan Lee's personal display-name override, not the calendar's real title.
Actually change the calendar's true title/summary, which requires Jordan Lee to own the calendar.
